# UiNumberInput

A numeric field whose value is a number or `null`, never a silently coerced zero.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { UiNumberInput } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiNumberInput from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiNumberInput'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiNumberInput.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiNumberInput.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the control invalid and is announced with it. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`) without showing a message. |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id of the native control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the label for assistive technology but hides it visually. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | `horizontal` puts the label beside the control when the container is wide enough. |
| `min` | `number` |  |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `step` | `number \| 'any'` |  |  |
| `controls` | `boolean` | `false` | Show decrement/increment buttons. |
| `controlAttrs` | `UiControlAttrs` |  | Attributes, listeners and a `ref` callback for the native control, for example Formisch's `field.props`. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `number \| null` | required | The number, or `null` when the field is empty or holds text the browser cannot parse. Never coerced to `0`. `undefined` is treated like `null`. |

## Attributes

class/style go to the root; every other attribute and listener (and `controlAttrs`) goes to the native control.

## Keyboard

- Arrow Up/Down step the value (native `type="number"`).

## Accessibility

- Native `<input type="number">` with `inputmode="decimal"`.
- Empty or unparsable text yields `null`; unparsable text also marks the field invalid with a translated message.
- The optional stepper buttons are pointer conveniences (`tabindex="-1"`) with translated names.

## Styling

- `.vui-field`, `.vui-field__label`, `.vui-field__hint`, `.vui-field__error`
- `.vui-input`, `.vui-input__steppers`, `.vui-input__button`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid max-w-md grid-cols-2 gap-3">
  <UiNumberInput v-model="amount" :label="t('demo.amount')" :min="0" :max="99" controls />
  <UiNumberInput v-model="amount" :label="t('demo.amount')" :step="0.5" />
</div>
<p class="mt-2 text-vui-sm text-vui-muted" data-testid="number-value">
  {{ t('demo.value', { value: String(amount) }) }}
</p>
```
